title: Replace DeterministicUUID's Unsafe hack with something less awful
description: DeterministicUUID uses sun.misc.Unsafe to replace the static final SecureRandom inside UUID$Holder with a seeded Random wrapper. This works but is fragile — it depends on JDK internals, requires --add-opens, and could break on JDK upgrades. Consider alternatives: (1) a custom UUID factory method used throughout XMage instead of UUID.randomUUID(), (2) a Java agent that instruments UUID.randomUUID(), (3) accept the Unsafe hack but add a JDK version check with a clear error message.
